# Audio sources

Owner's rule: Kenney CC0 or generated by us only; nothing imitating an existing game.

**Every file in `Assets/Resources/Audio/` is generated by `tools/make_music.py`.** No Kenney sample and no other third-party sound is used, so there is nothing to credit. The `_kenney` folder is not needed for audio.

Why no Kenney files: there is no Vorbis decoder on this machine, so `.ogg` samples could not be trimmed, measured or loudness-matched.

Rebuild: `python3 tools/make_music.py` renders everything and runs the checks (`music`, `sfx`, `verify`, or file names render part of it). It needs numpy in `.pylibs/` (`pip install --target .pylibs numpy`). Output is reproducible byte for byte.

Format: WAV, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit, mono. Total 39.6 MB. The melodies were written note by note for this game (they are in the script).

## Music

| File | Source | Key | BPM | Form |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| m_title | generated | G major | 138 | A A' B A'', heroic |
| m_city | generated | F major | 150 | A B A C, swung and bouncy |
| m_desert | generated | E Phrygian / Phrygian dominant | 116 | A A' B A' |
| m_factory | generated | D Dorian | 108 | A B A, swung funk, metal clanks |
| m_fortress | generated | G minor | 100 | A B A, snare march, brass, pad |
| m_boss | generated | B minor | 172 | A B A C A |
| m_battle | generated | A major | 184 | A B A C A |
| m_ending | generated | D major | 120 | 12 bars, held final chord, no loop |

Peak is -3 dBFS. The seven `m_` game tracks loop: notes, echo and filtering are computed on a circle, so anything ringing past the end lands on the start. `m_ending` plays once.

## Effects

| File | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|
| place | generated | bomb placed: pitched thud + tick |
| fuse | generated | soft tick |
| boom | generated | explosion: sub sweep, filtered noise, crack, rumble |
| boom2 | generated | explosion variant, double hit |
| brick | generated | noise grains + thud |
| kick | generated | thump + rising whoosh |
| power | generated | fast rising arpeggio |
| power_bad | generated | sizzle + falling pulse |
| hurt | generated | shield: glass partials + shards |
| die | generated | falling warble + thud |
| enemy_die | generated | up-down pop |
| exit_open | generated | rising bell figure + low door rumble |
| stage_clear | generated | jingle, C major |
| gameover | generated | jingle, A minor |
| teleport | generated | rising warble with repeats |
| wind | generated | one gust of filtered noise, not a loop |
| car | generated | two-note horn + passing whoosh |
| hurry | generated | two-tone alarm, 6 beeps |
| switch | generated | click-clack |
| jet | generated | fire roar with flutter |
| crumble | generated | rock grains + rumble |
| secret | generated | whole-tone bell run |
| boss_hit | generated | metal clang + thud |
| boss_roar | generated | low filtered growl |
| boss_die | generated | chain of explosions + falling tone |
| boss_warn | generated | low siren, 2 cycles |
| select | generated | short blip |
| confirm | generated | two-note up |
| battle_win | generated | jingle, C major |
| battle_lose | generated | jingle, chromatic fall |
| shrink | generated | stone thud + grind |
| countdown | generated | ONE 880 Hz beep, 0.17 s: play it once per count |

Loudness is the loudest 100 ms, approximately K-weighted, in three deliberate tiers: soft -21 (fuse, wind, switch, select, confirm), normal -15, heavy -12 (boom, boom2, boss_roar, boss_die). Peaks stay at or below -3 dBFS. Music measures about -12 on a 3 s window, so start with music at about 0.5 volume in Unity.

## Status

Checked numerically only. **Nobody has listened to any of it.**
